items.question: What was Shoni Schimmel's best WNBA season?
items.answer: Shoni Schimmel's best WNBA season was her 2014 rookie year with the Atlanta Dream, when she averaged 8.3 points, 2.2 rebounds and 3.6 assists in 34 regular-season games. Full Court Buckets has her regular-season lines for 2014, 2015, 2016 and 2018.

items.question: Where did Shoni Schimmel play college basketball?
items.answer: Shoni Schimmel played four seasons at Louisville, from 2010 to 2014. She helped the Cardinals reach the 2013 NCAA title game and was named an All-American as a senior.

items.question: Was Shoni Schimmel a WNBA All-Star?

items.question: Where is Shoni Schimmel from?
